faqs.q: How do I get a website made for my business?
faqs.a: Decide what the website has to do, and prepare your business details, photos and a few lines of text. Register a domain in your own name, then choose a website builder, an agency or a freelance designer, and get a written quote before work starts.

faqs.q: How long does it take to make a website?
faqs.a: A landing page usually takes one to two weeks, a business website two to four weeks, and an online store or catalogue four to eight weeks, depending on how ready the content is.

faqs.q: Do I need to know coding to get a website?
faqs.a: No. A designer and developer handles the building. You only need to explain the business and approve the design.

faqs.q: Can I get a website made remotely?
faqs.a: Yes. Projects can run entirely over calls, WhatsApp and email, with a live preview link to follow the work from anywhere in India.

faqs.q: How will customers find my website on Google?
faqs.a: Through a fast, well-structured site submitted to Google Search Console, a Google Business Profile linked to it, customer reviews, and links from directories and other sites.

faqs.q: क्या दूसरे शहर से वेबसाइट बनवा सकते हैं?
faqs.a: हाँ। पूरा प्रोजेक्ट कॉल, WhatsApp और ईमेल पर चल सकता है, और एक लाइव प्रीव्यू लिंक से आप भारत में कहीं से भी काम देख सकते हैं।

sections.title: What patients look for before they call
body: Most patients search on their phone, compare two or three clinics, and call the one that answers their questions fastest: what you treat, which doctor they will see, when you are open, where you are and how to book.
A clinic website does not need to be complicated. It needs to answer those questions in seconds, look trustworthy, and make booking or calling one tap away.

items.title: Appointment requests
items.text: A short form or a WhatsApp button that sends the request straight to your front desk.

items.title: Reviews and trust

items.text: Set up to appear when people search for your speciality near them, alongside your Google Business Profile.

steps.text: You approve the design first; the site is handed over once it is live.

faqs.q: Can lawyers and CAs have a website in India?
faqs.a: Yes. Professional bodies set rules on advertising and solicitation, so the site is written as an informational profile of the practice, services and credentials. Check your own body's current guidelines.

faqs.q: Can clients book a consultation online?
faqs.a: Yes. Through a booking calendar, a short form or WhatsApp, depending on how you work.

cta: Tell me what the site has to do for your business, and you will get a written quote with a timeline.
